## How this work is cited

Passages inside Gravity and Grace are identified by section and numbered fragment. Assembled after Weil's death by Gustave Thibon from her notebooks, chosen and ordered by him. It is therefore a selection rather than a work Weil composed, and the arrangement is Thibon's — a fact worth holding when a fragment is quoted as a considered position.

## The work in Simone Weil’s thought

Simone Weil (1909–1943) was a French philosopher, mystic, and political activist who taught, worked in factories, and engaged labor and anti-fascist causes. A brilliant Normalienne, she sought experiential solidarity with the oppressed. [More on Simone Weil](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/simone-weil) .
